# OneSignal

> > Multi-channel customer engagement platform providing push notifications, email, SMS, and in-app messaging solutions with comprehensive SDK integration for web, mobile (iOS/Android), and enterprise applications.

OneSignal is a developer-focused messaging platform that enables businesses to send push notifications, emails, SMS, and in-app messages across multiple channels. The platform offers SDKs for major platforms, integrates with Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) and Apple Push Notification service (APNs), and provides enterprise-grade security with GDPR compliance and SOC 2 certification.

## Key Topics

- Push notifications (web, mobile, iOS, Android)
- Email marketing and transactional messaging
- SMS and MMS messaging
- SDK integration (mobile and web)
- Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
- Apple Push Notification service (APNs)
- Service workers and HTTPS requirements
- Marketing automation and segmentation
- GDPR compliance and data security
- Multi-channel messaging campaigns
- In-app messaging and Live Activities
- Twilio integration for SMS
- Opensense email signature management
- User targeting and personalization

## Getting Started

- [OneSignal Customer Engagement Platform](https://staging.onesignal.com): OneSignal homepage: multi-channel messaging platform for push, email, SMS
- [OneSignal Documentation](https://documentation.onesignal.com): OneSignal docs homepage: guides, SDK setup, API reference for messaging
- [Quickstart Guide](https://documentation.onesignal.com/docs/en/quickstart-guide): OneSignal quickstart: account setup, channels, users, first message tutorial

## Platform Setup Guides

- [Mobile Push Setup](https://documentation.onesignal.com/docs/en/mobile-push-setup): Mobile push guide: FCM/APNs credentials, SDK setup, iOS/Android permissions
- [Web Push Setup](https://documentation.onesignal.com/docs/en/web-push-setup): Web push setup guide: HTTPS, service worker, SDK integration for browsers
- [Email Setup](https://documentation.onesignal.com/docs/en/email-setup): Complete email configuration guide with DNS, domain verification, providers
- [Android Firebase Credentials](https://documentation.onesignal.com/docs/en/android-firebase-credentials): Guide to generating Firebase FCM credentials for Android push notifications

## Troubleshooting & Support

- [Mobile SDK Troubleshooting](https://documentation.onesignal.com/docs/en/mobile-troubleshooting): Mobile SDK troubleshooting: Firebase conflicts, notification delivery issues
- [Web Push FAQ](https://documentation.onesignal.com/docs/en/web-push-setup-faq): Web push FAQ: browser compatibility, HTTPS requirements, iOS support
- [Data Collection & Security FAQs](https://documentation.onesignal.com/docs/en/data-questions): OneSignal data security, GDPR/HIPAA compliance, SOC 2/ISO certifications FAQ
- [SMS FAQ](https://documentation.onesignal.com/docs/en/sms-faq): SMS/MMS troubleshooting: E.164 format, Twilio integration, encoding issues

## Additional Products

- [Opensense Email Signature Management](https://smart.onesignal.com): Opensense email signature management integrated with Microsoft 365/Google
